mapper.sql: owner_id=CAST(#{owner} AS uuid) AND agent_id=CAST(#{agent} AS uuid)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_memory_policy(agent_id) VALUES(CAST(#{agent} AS uuid)) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM agent_memory_policy WHERE agent_id=CAST(#{agent} AS uuid)
SELECT * FROM agent_memory_policy WHERE agent_id=CAST(#{agent} AS uuid) FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_memory_policy SET enabled=#{enabled},mode=#{mode},generation=generation+1 WHERE agent_id=CAST(#{agent} AS uuid) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chat_session s WHERE s.agent_id=CAST(#{agent} AS uuid) AND s.active_request IS NOT NULL AND s.locked_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM long_memory WHERE AND NOT deleted ORDER BY updated_at DESC,id LIMIT 200
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO long_memory(id,owner_id,agent_id,category,memory_key,content,manual,enabled,expires_at) VALUES(CAST(#{id} AS uuid),CAST(#{owner} AS uuid),CAST(#{agent} AS uuid), #{category},#{key},#{content},TRUE,#{enabled},CAST(#{expires} AS timestamptz)) ON CONFLICT(owner_id,agent_id,memory_key) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE long_memory SET content=CASE WHEN #{deleted} THEN '' ELSE #{content} END, evidence=CASE WHEN #{deleted} THEN NULL ELSE evidence END, source_session=CASE WHEN #{deleted} THEN NULL ELSE source_session END, source_request=CASE WHEN #{deleted} THEN NULL ELSE source_request END, enabled=#{enabled},deleted=#{deleted}, expires_at=CAST(#{expires} AS timestamptz),manual=TRUE,version=version+1, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE AND id=CAST(#{id} AS uuid) AND version=#{version} AND NOT deleted
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO long_memory_job(request_id,owner_id,agent_id,session_id,source_order,generation) SELECT turn.id,session.owner_user_id,session.agent_id,session.id,turn.sequence,policy.generation FROM chat_turn turn JOIN chat_session session ON session.id=turn.session_id JOIN agent_memory_policy policy ON policy.agent_id=session.agent_id AND policy.enabled WHERE turn.id=CAST(#{request} AS uuid) AND turn.status='completed' AND session.owner_user_id=CAST(#{owner} AS uuid) AND session.agent_id=CAST(#{agent} AS uuid) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: UPDATE long_memory_job SET status='running',claim=CAST(#{claim} AS uuid), attempts=attempts+1,leased_until=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP+INTERVAL '90 seconds' WHERE request_id=( SELECT request_id FROM long_memory_job WHERE status='pending' OR (status='running' AND leased_until < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY created_at FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1 ) RETURNING *

SELECT turn.user_content,user_account.enabled AS user_enabled FROM chat_turn turn JOIN chat_session session ON session.id=turn.session_id JOIN platform_user user_account ON user_account.id=session.owner_user_id WHERE turn.id=CAST(#{request} AS uuid) AND session.owner_user_id=CAST(#{owner} AS uuid) AND session.agent_id=CAST(#{agent} AS uuid) AND turn.status='completed'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO long_memory(id,owner_id,agent_id,category,memory_key,content,evidence, source_session,source_request,source_order) VALUES(CAST(#{id} AS uuid),CAST(#{owner} AS uuid),CAST(#{agent} AS uuid), #{category},#{key},#{content},#{evidence},CAST(#{session} AS uuid), CAST(#{request} AS uuid),#{sourceOrder}) ON CONFLICT(owner_id,agent_id,memory_key) DO UPDATE SET category=EXCLUDED.category,content=EXCLUDED.content,evidence=EXCLUDED.evidence, source_session=EXCLUDED.source_session,source_request=EXCLUDED.source_request, source_order=EXCLUDED.source_order,version=long_memory.version+1, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE NOT long_memory.manual AND NOT long_memory.deleted AND long_memory.enabled AND long_memory.source_order < EXCLUDED.source_order
mapper.update: UPDATE long_memory_job SET status=#{status},model_name=#{model}, prompt_tokens=#{prompt},completion_tokens=#{completion},total_tokens=#{total}, error_message=#{error},completed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,leased_until=NULL WHERE request_id=CAST(#{request} AS uuid) AND claim=CAST(#{claim} AS uuid) AND status='running' AND leased_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT request_id,session_id,status,attempts,model_name,prompt_tokens,completion_tokens, total_tokens,error_message,created_at,completed_at FROM long_memory_job WHERE ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10
